verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents creating 'tens, hundreds, or even thousands' of inboxes on demand, and AgentID lets an agent sign in to providers using an AgentMail inbox as its identity. That gives separate per-sign-up addresses, which loosely achieves the goal of not exposing a primary address. However, nothing documents true alias or masked-address functionality, such as forwarding aliases tied to a real mailbox or a privacy-masking feature for human users. Missing for 10: documented alias/masked-address forwarding to a real inbox, per-alias disable/revoke controls, a privacy-focused switcher workflow, and independent corroboration.
